app.desktop-only: NeuralSnap only runs as a desktop app.
band.title: Screenshot
empty.hint: Press the shortcut or click the button: the screen freezes. Drag a region, click a window or press Enter for the whole screen.
ov.hint: Drag: region · Click: window · Enter: full screen · Esc: cancel
pin.tip: Drag: move · Wheel: zoom · Double-click or Esc: close · Right-click: menu
toast.kept: The editor keeps its capture. The new one is on the clipboard and, with automatic saving on, in the captures folder.
notify.copied-only: Automatic saving is off: the capture is only on the clipboard.
err.grabber-missing: The screen grabber (sngrab.exe) is missing. Try installing NeuralSnap again.
err.grab-failed: The screen could not be captured: {error}
err.no-picture: There is no picture to export.
err.shortcut-taken: The shortcut is used by another program: {accel}
err.shortcut-invalid: This key combination cannot be used: pick a key together with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
saveas.title: Save as
tray.balloon: The shortcut is used by another program: {accel}. Open Settings from the NeuralSnap icon in the notification area and pick another shortcut.
set.title: Settings
set.shortcut.text: Starts a new capture from anywhere. To change it, click the button, then press the new keys.
set.capture: Press a key together with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win. Esc to cancel.
set.autosave.text: Every capture is saved in this folder as a PNG, named after the moment it was taken.
set.editor: Open the editor after a capture
set.editor.text: When off, a capture is only copied to the clipboard (and saved), and a notification appears.
set.autostart.text: Turned on or off with the "NeuralSnap: start with Windows" option of the Neural setup.
unsaved.title: Unsaved annotations
unsaved.capture: The annotations on the capture in the editor are not saved. Save them before the new capture opens?
unsaved.quit: The annotations on the capture in the editor are not saved. Save them before NeuralSnap closes?
about.text: The screenshot tool of the Neural series. A shortcut freezes the screen; it takes a region, a window or the whole screen, copies it to the clipboard and saves it. Mark it up with arrows, boxes, a pen, text, a highlighter and pixelation that cannot be undone; open it in NeuralView or pin it to the screen.
about.hint: Version {version} · The screen is captured by sngrab.exe (Windows GDI); captures only stay on disk when they are saved.
keys.overlay: While capturing: region, window, full screen, cancel
